findings.publisher: WAFA (attributing figures to Gaza medical sources)
findings.affected_population_system: Gaza hospitals reportedly received four fatalities and seven wounded in past 24 hours; cumulative figures 74,746 killed, 176,234 wounded since 7 October 2023; 1,679 fatalities and 6,100 wounded reported since October 2025 ceasefire
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Gaza Strip hospitals received four fatalities and seven wounded individuals in the past 24 hours.
findings.source_type: Palestinian news agency citing local medical sources; reported aggregate, not independently audited casualty verification
